question: Are there states where the female mortality rate exceeds the male mortality rate? (A) Yes, exactly one state (B) No, male is higher in every state (C) Yes, about half of the states. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the public_health scatter chart. The y-axis runs to 5x the data max, squashing the points into the bottom of the plot. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): inappropriate axis range. True answer: A (Yes, exactly one state). Bait: B (No, male is higher in every state).
